verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a workflow and task orchestration platform with a dashboard and TUI for observability. A product of this kind could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as summaries of failed runs, so the axis applies. The pack shows no built-in AI insight or suggestion feature. The agent-tools and support-agent cookbooks are developer building blocks for building your own agents, not in-product AI insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
